research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Contentsquare is researching and developing systems for digital experience analytics, including methods for automatic snapshot selection and zone creation, frustration scoring systems, interactive heatmaps for websites, unsupervised user segment discovery, and real-time alerting systems. Their work also covers session replay with multiple browser tabs, product exposure metrics, and techniques for providing event streams and analytics for activity on websites, highlighting a focus on user behavior analysis, website optimization, and customer feedback integration.

about_short_description.short_description: Contentsquare is an AI platform that provides product analytics, customer feedback, digital experience analytics, and monitoring services.

product.name: Contentsquare Platform
product.description: A cloud-based experience intelligence platform that analyzes digital user journeys and combines behavioral, product, feedback, and monitoring data to support engagement, conversion, and retention decisions.

product.name: Experience Analytics
product.description: An analytics product for understanding how users interact with digital pages and journeys, using behavioral data to identify engagement patterns, friction, and conversion opportunities.

product.name: Product Analytics
product.description: An analytics product for measuring how users adopt and use digital products, helping teams analyze journeys, feature engagement, conversion, retention, and drop-off behavior.

product.name: Experience Monitoring
product.description: A digital experience monitoring product that detects errors, slowdowns, and user frustration so teams can identify and resolve issues affecting online journeys.

product.name: Voice of Customer
product.description: A customer feedback product for collecting and analyzing user opinions, survey responses, and experience feedback to identify needs, satisfaction issues, and improvement priorities.

product.name: Sense
product.description: An AI analytics capability that lets users query Contentsquare data in natural language and receive automated analyses, findings, and recommended next steps.
